summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs) is itself obfuscated with `_0x`-style identifiers and per-function string dictionaries. On `npm install`, it downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13) and uses `execFileSync` to run a locally-shipped 727KB obfuscated bundle (math_init.js, a `@bun-cjs` bundle with string-array rotation obfuscation). Bun is fetched specifically because Node cannot execute the payload, so the bundle's behavior is not visible to standard Node-based scanners. The package is presented as a TypeScript monorepo test package, which does not require a downloaded alternate JavaScript runtime to execute an opaque 727KB bundle at install time. The combination of an obfuscated install-time script, an alternate-runtime dropper against a purpose-mismatched, undocumented sibling payload, and end-to-end obfuscation of the executed content is the install-time RCE pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
